visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white faux-fur coat, black beanie, and black leather boots, walks up a set of red concrete stairs towards a restaurant entrance. The background is a vibrant red wall with a lit circular lamp hanging from the ceiling. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese introduce the Seoul food diary. (2) Close-up shots of a golden pot simmering on a portable gas stove inside a restaurant with brick walls. The pot contains a red, spicy-looking broth with instant noodles, thick slices of green onion, and a large mound of minced garlic. The woman is seen using metal chopsticks to lift noodles and a large boiled potato slice to her mouth. (3) The setting shifts to an outdoor street at night where the woman points at a restaurant sign before entering a clean, modern dining space. Inside, she is shown eating a fluffy, yellow steamed egg dish from a black ceramic pot. The camera zooms in on thick slices of pork belly sizzling on a black grill pan, being flipped and cut by staff using metal tongs and scissors. (4) A montage sequence shows the neon-lit exterior of a restaurant in the Sinchon district at night. Inside, a menu with Chinese text is shown, followed by a massive circular platter containing quadrants of red raw beef, seasoned green chives, and rice topped with cockles and seaweed. The woman uses a spoon to mix the ingredients and takes a large bite. (5) The final segment features a traditional-looking restaurant exterior with wooden signage. A bowl of clear beef soup with rice and thinly sliced beef is served in a brass bowl. The woman adds chopped green onions and a slice of red kimchi to her spoon before eating. The video concludes with her smiling at the camera in the brightly lit indoor setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 首爾美食日記. [Slogan]: 分享四間我覺得好吃的😋. (2) [Subtitle]: 弘大 蒜頭辣雞湯. [Subtitle]: 超愛這家 每次來韓國必吃!. (3) [Subtitle]: 濃濃的蒜頭湯底 有年糕、馬鈴薯、多塊雞肉. [Subtitle]: 一定要加點韓國拉麵. (4) [Subtitle]: 我不敢吃太辣 但這間辣度可以接受 真的很香 每次都吃的很滿足. [Subtitle]: 馬鈴薯也很大塊. (5) [Subtitle]: 有分大中小鍋 兩個人點最小鍋 料就很豐富了 雞肉超多!! 不會很柴很乾. (6) [Subtitle]: 來首爾一定要來這間我大推!!. (7) [Subtitle]: 聖水洞烤肉店 안목 수비드목살구이. [Subtitle]: 韓國餐廳附的小菜都很豐富. (8) [Subtitle]: 蒸蛋有淡淡的焦香味. [Subtitle]: 蠻推這間的原因是店內環境很乾淨舒適 不會覺得地板桌子油油的. (9) [Subtitle]: 來韓國就是要吃烤豬肉😋 店員會幫你烤. [Subtitle]: 這個烤白菜意外好吃 搭配烤肉一起比較不油膩. (10) [Subtitle]: 豬肉就是要烤的像這樣黃金焦脆😋. [Subtitle]: 也有主食可以點 他的冷麵非常好吃! 清爽 麵條Q彈. (11) [Subtitle]: 想吃韓國烤肉又怕環境油膩 可以參考這間!. (12) [Subtitle]: 新村 生牛肉蛤蜊拌飯 단골손님신촌점. [Subtitle]: 店位置在二樓. (13) [Subtitle]: 有中文菜單 毛蛤有點類似蛤蜊? (比較小顆的). (14) [Subtitle]: 點了一個部隊鍋 (也必須加韓國拉麵😋). [Subtitle]: 主角登場 我點生牛肉x蛤蜊拌飯. (15) [Subtitle]: 這個毛蛤 (蛤蜊) 真的蠻小的. [Subtitle]: 先嚐一口 之後再全部拌一起. (16) [Subtitle]: 味道很不錯! 不會辣又很入味. [Subtitle]: 拌飯很可以!! 不敢吃生牛肉的人也能點烤肉拌飯👍. (17) [Subtitle]: 明洞 河東館牛肉湯飯. [Subtitle]: 菜單很簡單 就是牛肉湯飯 可以加點肉片或內臟類. (18) [Subtitle]: 愛吃蔥如我 怕味道太淡可以再加點鹽. [Subtitle]: 配點泡菜提味. (19) [Subtitle]: 牛肉湯很鮮甜 天很冷來喝碗肉湯超超滿足💕. [Subtitle]: 吃太多天重口味的 想吃清淡的可以來吃牛肉湯飯~~. (20) [Subtitle]: 美食日記分享到這邊 掰掰囉.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic dance pop music featuring a female vocalist singing in Korean begins immediately. The tempo is approximately 124 BPM with a strong, driving electronic beat and bright synth melodies. There is no human speech from the person on screen. (2) A distinct bubbling and sizzling sound effect is introduced as the visuals show the cooking pot and the grill. These sounds have a high spectral frequency and are mixed clearly over the background music to emphasize the sensory experience of the food. (3) A metallic clinking sound occurs when a spoon hits a brass bowl, followed by the muffled sound of glasses clinking in a toast. The background music maintains its high energy and steady beat, with the female vocals continuing in a rhythmic fashion. (4) The audio intensity remains high with the music continuing until a final melodic resolution and a quick fade-out at the end of the video. The environmental room tone is largely masked by the high-volume production music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Restaurant 1 -> Restaurant 2 -> Restaurant 3 -> Restaurant 4 -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle and food recommendation vlog aimed at travelers visiting Seoul. It showcases four distinct dining experiences (spicy chicken, BBQ, raw beef bibimbap, and beef soup rice) to provide variety and practical tips for tourists, such as the availability of Chinese menus and the comfort of the dining environments.
